title: Apple HomeView teardown: a step backward in repairability compared to recent iPads and HomePods, with heavily glued display, speakers, and logic board (Carsten Frauenheim/iFixit News)
summary: Carsten Frauenheim / iFixit News: Apple HomeView teardown: a step backward in repairability compared to recent iPads and HomePods, with heavily glued display, speakers, and logic board — Apple's first iPad-stuck-to-a-HomePod smarthome hub landed on our teardown table this week, and we figured we knew what we were getting into.
